chapter.li: LEChapter3 Verse1 The manner which the disciples, which were called the elders of the church, ordained priests and teachers. VerseEnd Verse2 After they had prayed unto the Father in the name of Christ, they laid their hands upon them and said, VerseEnd Verse3 In the name of Jesus Christ, I ordain 2PSF you to be a priest (or if he be a teacher, I ordain 2PSF you to be a teacher) to preach repentance and remission of sins through Jesus Christ by the endurance of faith on his name to the end. Amen. VerseEnd Verse4 And after this manner did they ordain priests and teachers, according to the gifts and callings of God unto men. And they ordained them by the power of the holy ghost which was in them. VerseEnd
